title: State to remember
description: What a skill that compares over time asks the agent to save for the next run. Copied into properties.state_out of each output schema that has a state_out property. The skill never saves it; a later write step does (Sheets, Notion, a memory connector, or platform memory once it exists).

fingerprint.description: A short, stable summary of what was observed (e.g. sorted event urls, a price string), compared on the next run to detect change.

data.description: Small extra fields the next run needs. Keep it under 2 KB.
